title: HL TP/SL Orders: Silent Failure → On-Chain Protection

context.task: Fix TP/SL orders not being placed on Hyperliquid exchange
context.symptom: Open Orders (TP/SL): 0 — no exit protection despite _place_tpsl being called
context.starting_state: AVAX and SUI positions had zero on-chain exit orders for 6+ hours
context.ending_state: 4 trigger orders placed and verified (2 SL + 2 TP for both positions)

root_cause.primary: _place_tpsl() was passing wrong arg types to exchange.order()
details: limit_px=None — SDK expects float, None caused exception
triggerPx=str(price) — SDK expects float, str may cause type mismatch
try/except swallowed the exception with only logger.warning(), no traceback
root_cause.why_undetected: Zero log output because the exception was caught before any logging happened. No 'TP/SL set' or 'placement failed' messages appeared in logs.

code_changes: Changed limit_px from None to float(sl_price)/float(tp_price)
Changed triggerPx from str(price) to float(price)
Upgraded exception handler from logger.warning to logger.error with exc_info=True
Added result validation (sl_ok/tp_ok) with detailed partial-failure logging
fix.verification: Manually placed TP/SL for both AVAX and SUI via VPS Python shell, confirmed 4 resting orders on-chain

discovery_technique.method: Compared open_orders count (0) with expected (4) from screenshot
discovery_technique.key_insight: If _place_tpsl is called at line 534 but no orders appear, the function must be silently failing
discovery_technique.verification_command: info.open_orders(wallet_address) showed 0, then 4 after manual fix

anti_pattern_extracted.name: silent_exception_swallow
anti_pattern_extracted.description: try/except with logger.warning() in critical execution paths hides real bugs. The TP/SL bug persisted for the entire session because no error was visible.
anti_pattern_extracted.fix_pattern: Use logger.error(msg, exc_info=True) for trade execution paths. Consider returning success/failure boolean.
